title: Encoding of cerebellar dentate neuron activity during visual attention in rhesus macaques
goal: Reproduce the original Figure 3 dentate category-encoding and Figure 4 current/past neural-decoding findings as separately reported components, preserving each panel's source-defined cohort, conditions, model comparisons and indispensable controls. Report any qualified encoding-model or decoder improvement on that same named component and common observation support; success on one component cannot discharge the other or establish improved biological effects. No blanket Figure 1–4, PCA/ramping or whole-paper obligation is implied.
